title: Pony Power Therapies
specs: Therapeutic horseback riding benefits physical, social and emotional well-being
Horses selected for temperament, size and quality of movement
Programs include life skills, safety, awareness, and responsibility
Riders must be cleared medically and considered safe and appropriate by staff
Meet height and weight guidelines for horses
Able to tolerate wearing an ASTM-approved riding helmet for entire lesson
Volunteers must be at least 14 years old for lessons; morning Farm Crew volunteers must be 18 or older
All lesson volunteers must be able to walk for at least 90 minutes and jog for short stints
Corporate volunteer groups start at $500 for 10 people for 2-hour experience

blurb: Pony Power Therapies offers therapeutic horseback riding, horse-assisted learning, garden-assisted learning, and group life skills sessions. Programs focus on physical, social, and emotional well-being through interaction with horses and nature. Lessons are structured with instructors and volunteers, tailored to individual needs and abilities.
extraNote: Lessons booked by semester; no single lessons offered · Parents/guardians/caregivers must stay on site during all individual lessons
